This repository contains the code and original data behind "Temperature-dependent RNA editing in octopus extensively recodes the neural proteome" by Birk et al. Most figures in the paper can be reproduced here.

To recreate most figures, choose the relevant file as named. See create data_objects.R for the code to create the data_objects.Rdata file.

[![](https://zenodo.org/badge/DOI/10.5281/zenodo.14749076.svg)](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.cell.2023.05.004)

This repository is a fork of the repository published with["Temperature-dependent RNA editing in octopus extensively recodes the neural proteoms" by Birk et al] (https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/pii/S0092867423005238).This fork contains a rewritten README and some additional minor modifications as part of a learning experience for BIFX 572
